title: StericX: physical-organic molecular featurization and reaction-selectivity inference
description: StericX is an independent, from-scratch Rust reimplementation of the Kraken Sterimol and coordination-aware buried-volume ligand descriptors, together with a reproduction of the Ni-catalyzed homo-Diels-Alder selectivity study. The descriptor kernels are validated against morfeus to numerical precision and against Kraken's published values on the authors' own DFT geometries (1,541 ligands, R^2 = 0.9852; 11 Ni-hDA ligands, R^2 = 0.9986). It is an honest reproduction: negative results and known limitations are reported rather than hidden. Dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.
